Phil porte-t-il une perruque ?

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Amedeo Modigliani. You will discover his labour with Caryatid, Lolotte or others portraits.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Pierre Bonnard. You will discover his labour with Woman dozing on a bed, Summer in Normandy or The beach in low tide.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Au 16ème siècle, le cardinal Scipione Borghèse, neveu du Pape, fait construire une villa pour accueillir spécialement sa collection privée d’œuvres d’art, l’une des plus importantes de l’époque. Achetée par l’Etat italien en 1902, cette collection d’une immense richesse rassemble des chefs d’œuvres inestimables signés par les plus grands artistes. Découvrez ainsi l’une des copies de Léda et le cygne de De Vinci ou le David de Caravage. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Probablement le peintre le plus renommé du monde, Vincent van Gogh est née aux Pays-Bas en 1853 mais a passé la plus grande partie de sa vie en France.Souffrant de trouble mental, Van Gogh a produit plus de 2000 peintures avant de se suicider à l’âge de 37 ans. Pendant cette visite, vous allez pouvoir découvrir ses plus grandes oeuvres, avec notamment deux « Auto-portraits » exposé au Musée d'Orsay, « Les Tournesols » exposé à la Galere Nationale de Londres, « La Nuit étoilée », et « L’église d’Auvers-sur-Oise ».Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: Le centre municipal de Säynätsalo d'Alvar Aalto
programme.desc: Un chef-d’œuvre humaniste d’Alvar Aalto au cœur de la Finlande. Un hommage moderne à la Cité Idéale de la Renaissance Italienne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: C’est l’un des artistes les plus controversés et pourtant, l’un des plus influents. La collection de Picasso contenait principalement des Renoir. Matisse le vénérait. Monet également. Renoir a été crucial dans la création du mouvement impressionniste, avant de le rejeter totalement pour se lancer dans un genre radicalement différent, avec beaucoup de succès. La Collection Barnes à Philadelphie possède plus de toiles de Renoir que n’importe quelle autre galerie au monde et c’est là que nous tenterons de lever le voile sur l’histoire remarquable de cet incroyable artiste.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Réputé pour être le créateur de la peinture à l’huile, le peintre flamand Jan van Eyck (1390-1441) est un artiste majeur du 15ème siècle. Il est considéré comme étant le fondateur du portrait occidental qu’il a pratiqué très méticuleusement. Regardez de près la fameux « Portrait d’Arnolfini » exposé à la Galerie Nationale de Londres, le miroir circulaire au fond de la pièce montre le reflet de l’artiste. « La vierge du chancelier Rolin » exposé au Louvre, quant à elle montre une image dans laquelle trois arcs s’ouvrent sur un paysage fluvial.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'humoriste et animateur Jim Moir et sa femme Nancy Sorrell partent en road trip dans le Kent aujourd'hui.Mieux connu sous le nom de Vic Reeves, Jim apporte sa touche d'humour unique à l'achat d'antiquités. De son côté, Nancy, mannequin et présentatrice télé, sait aussi marchander et elle est très compétitive ! Le couple est accompagné par les experts Charlie Ross et Thomas Plant.Soyez attentif au don surprenant de Jim pour deviner l’âge de presque tout, à Dixon traversant les chutes du Niagara et à une leçon de navigation par longitude.Et surtout, la mystérieuse Mme Parker fera-t-elle son apparition à la vente aux enchères ?

programme.title: Lyon : When art covers the walls
programme.desc: 2000 years of history, mondial cradle of cinema, gastronomic capital… The reputation of Lyon are not more to do. However, there’s a specificity in Lyon that is a special city in France : Murals painting. Discover some of these murals painting, between graphic vertigo and Lyon identity.

programme.title: The magnificent industry: a look of art on the world of industry
programme.desc: In this documentary, we will discover the works and the actors of the project of the city of Strasbourg which celebrates the link between art and industry.

programme.title: Parish enclosures: Books of stone books of wood
programme.desc: Parish enclosures are the hallmark of Western Brittany, formulating its soul and being from the late 15th to the 17th century. The ultimate accord of the tragic, the sacred, the aesthetic and the religious, such is the journey to which we invite you.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Phil Grabsky, réalisateur récompensé à plusieurs reprises, pose un regard neuf sur celui qui est sans conteste l’artiste le plus aimé au monde en utilisant les mots du peintre lui-même. Moi, Claude Monet révèle de nouvelles facettes de l’homme qui a donné naissance au mouvement impressionniste grâce à un tableau et qui fut certainement l’un des peintres les plus influents et renommés du XIXe et du début du XXe siècle. Tourné à travers l’Europe, sur les lieux où il a peint, Moi, Claude Monet est une exploration filmique inédite et intime de certains des décors cultes les plus appréciés de l’art occidental.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Le rockeur progressif Rick Wakeman et son grand ami Ian Lavender, célèbre pour son rôle de Pike dans Dad’s Army, s’offrent une joyeuse virée sur les routes secondaires du Norfolk. Accompagnés des experts Raj Bisram et David Harper, ces deux chasseurs d’antiquités sillonnent le comté à la recherche de trésors à vendre aux enchères à Nottingham.Rick découvre d’anciens graffitis médiévaux cachés dans la cathédrale de Norwich, tandis qu’Ian fait un détour vers le nord du Norfolk pour admirer la plus grande collection de soldats miniatures au monde.Mais un sage vieil homme japonais aidera-t-il Ian à triompher aux enchères ?

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will discuss with Spencer Tunick, an American visual photographer. He is known for his photographic compositions featuring hundreds of volunteers, men and women, posing nude, mostly in urban settings. He does not define himself as a photographer, but as a creator of installations, the photos being only the representation of his works.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Picasso. Blue and Pink" at the Musée d'Orsay in Paris. This is an exceptional event because it is the first exhibition in France dedicated to the artist's blue and pink period. This exhibition brings together about 300 works by the artist during this period from 1900 to 1906, including "Woman with a Fan". During this period of his life, Picasso was between 18 and 25 years old and began to assert his artistic identity.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Red, art and utopia in the land of the Soviets" at the Grand Palais in Paris. This exhibition focuses on how the communist project generated specific art forms throughout the Soviet period and more precisely from the October Revolution until the death of Stalin in 1953.

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Women Painters, four centuries of struggle
programme.desc: Do the names of Rosa Bonheur or Artemisia Gentileschi ring any bell to you? Despite their skills, female painters were for long time ignored by art historians and remain unknown to the public. This documentary recalls the destinies and masterpieces of those women, between the 16th and the 20th century. Who are they? And what did they bring to the art field?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vermeer and music - the art of love and leisure
programme.desc: La National Gallery de Londres propose un nouveau regard sur l'un des plus grands artistes de tous les temps, Johannes Vermeer. Il est le peintre de la célèbre toile “La Jeune Fille à la perle”. Dans une exposition intitulée "Vermeer et la musique : L'art de l'amour et des loisirs

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: David Hockney à la Royal Academy of Arts
programme.desc: David Hockney, généralement considéré comme l’un des artistes britanniques les plus populaires, connaît un succès mondial grâce à ses expositions à Londres, New York, Paris et ailleurs qui attirent des millions de spectateurs. Devenu récemment octogénaire, Hockney ne semble pas avoir l’intention de lever le pied ni de perdre son audace légendaire. Ce film révèle des interviews intimes et inédites et se concentre sur deux expositions à succès ayant eu lieu en 2012 et 2016 à la Royal Academy of Arts Londres. Le réalisateur Phil Grabsky a bénéficié d’un accès privilégié pour célébrer sur grand écran ce génie créatif du XXIe siècle.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vincent Van Gogh : une nouvelle façon de voir
programme.desc: La vie de Vincent van Gogh reste entourée de mystère : folie, maladie, suicide, les ingrédients pour créer un mythe sont tous réunis. Bénéficiant d’un accès complet et sans précédent aux trésors du Van Gogh Museum d’Amsterdam, ce documentaire met en lumière à la fois l’un des artistes préférés du monde et la collection riche et unique du musée. Découvrez ces merveilleux chefs-d’œuvre sur grand écran pendant que quelques invités y compris les conservateurs de renommée mondiale et des historiens de l’art offrent leurs interprétations et des explications sur le travail de Van Gogh.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Art Quiz
programme.desc: Test your knowledge and your memory in fine arts, architecture, photography, street art and a dozen other topics with our Art Quiz popups !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: With his considerable production of more than 6,000 works, Auguste Renoir took part in the emergence of the impressionist movement even if he were to distance himself from it later to assert a more personal style. This visit begins with his most famous masterpiece, the “Ball at the Moulin de la Galette”. You will also rediscover the “Dance in the City” and the “Piano Lesson” exposed at the Joslyn art museum as well as “Claude Renoir in Clown Costume”, a portrait of his son who was later to become one of France’s greatest film directors exposed at the Orangerie Museum in France Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. Watch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Caravaggio. You will discover his labour with Bacchus, Mary Magdalene or Christ at the Column.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Italien painter, Sandro Botticelli.You will discover his labour with Abundance or autumn, The story of virginia, Venus and Mars.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Les impressionnistes - et l'homme qui les a créés
programme.desc: Ce sont les artistes les plus populaires du monde. Les œuvres de Cézanne, Monet, Degas et leurs compatriotes représentent des richesses inestimables. Mais qui étaient-ils vraiment ? Comment et pourquoi ont-ils révolutionné l’histoire de l’art ? Qu’est-ce qui se cache derrière leur succès intemporel ? Pour répondre à ces questions, le documentaire a obtenu un accès unique à une grande exposition mettant l’accent sur le collectionneur d’art parisien du 19ème siècle, Paul Durand-Ruel, l’expert des Impressionnistes qui prit la décision courageuse d’exposer les Impressionnistes à New York en 1886 et ainsi introduire la société américaine à la peinture française moderne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: “Happiness is an angel with a serious face.” These words by the Italian painter Amadeo Modgliani define to perfection the portraits which made him famous… He reinvented the icon, with his oval faces, his elongated necks and lapis-lazuli eyes which are strangely expressive even when robbed of substance. You will be able to appreciate the simplicity of his figures, the restraint in his lines and colours, especially when you admire “The Woman with the Blue Eyes” or the “Portrait of Anna Zborowska”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Né en 1866 à Moscou, Wassily Kandinsky est considéré comme l’un des artistes les plus importants du 20ème siècle. Il est notamment le fondateur de l’art abstrait. Il quitte la Russie pour aller en Allemagne lorsqu’il devient professeur à Bauhaus en 1922, et s’installe par la suite en France en 1933, laissant derrière lui un travail très abondant. Vous allez re-découvrir ses créations les plus emblématiques, principalement exposé au Centre Pompidou à Paris.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In the late 18th century (between 1775 and 1779), Claude Nicolas Ledoux built a monumental factory for the King of France in Franche-Comté. A revolution in architecture, a decade before the full-blown Revolution. Ledoux wanted to reinvent architecture, just as Rousseau wanted to reinvent the Social Contract, by returning to the sources, to "natural principles". It was both an aesthetic revolution, an innovative industrial site and the nucleus of an ideal city that would never see the light of day.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Painting the Modern Garden - Monet to Matisse
programme.desc: Passionné d’horticulture, Monet reste sans conteste le maître de la peinture de jardins dans l’histoire de l’art, mais il n’était pas seul. Des artistes tels que Van Gogh, Bonnard, Picasso et Matisse ont utilisé le jardin comme thème fort de leur œuvre. Ces grands artistes, ainsi que bien d’autres noms célèbres, sont rassemblés dans une exposition innovante du Cleveland Museum of Art et de la Royal Gallery of Arts de Londres. De l’exposition elle-même à la beauté des jardins d’artistes comme celui de Monet à Giverny, nous partons en voyage pour découvrir comment le jardin moderne était utilisé pour explorer de nouvelles idées radicales et merveilleuses.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Originaire de la ville de Grasse dans le sud de la France, Jean-Honoré Fragonard est le peintre français le plus emblématique du 18ème siècle. Il a étudié à l’académie française à Rome mais à choisi de devenir libre dans son travail, préférant effectuer des commissions privées, dont certaines ont eu du succès comme « La chemise enlevée » exposé au Louvre. « Fanciful Figure » exposé au Louvre-Lens quant à elle démontre un style très moderne et original. L’un de ses chefs-d’oeuvre est sans aucun doute le tableau « Le Boulon », appartenant aujourd’hui à la collection du Louvre à Paris.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or rediscover the masterpieces by Gustave Moreau (1826-1898) on display at the Musée d'Orsay, the Gustave Moreau Museum in Paris...

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Strictly Come Dancing’s Zoe Ball and Ian Waite are quickstepping their way across the south West of England in a bid to turn a profit at auction in Hampshire. Experts Margie Cooper and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to guide. Paul shares a secret with Zoe about buying antique hair brushes. Ian, though, offers dancing lessons to dealers to secure a discount. Lordy! Zoe also hears how one village became world famous for lace production while Ian ends up meeting a giant horse with its own boat.

programme.title: Women Painters, four centuries of struggle
programme.desc: Do the names of Rosa Bonheur or Artemisia Gentileschi ring any bell to you? Despite their skills, female painters were for long time ignored by art historians and remain unknown to the public. This documentary recalls the destinies and masterpieces of those women, between the 16th and the 20th century. Who are they? And what did they bring to the art field?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we meet Cheryl Dunn, photographer. After moving to New York City in the mid-1980s, she spent much of her career photographing the city's streets and the people who made their mark on them. In the late 1990s, she began to focus on film, creating classic films about artists of her generation who influenced the realities of urban life through their own work.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition "Cubism" at the Centre Pompidou. This exhibition gathers more than 300 works and focuses on the history of this founding movement of the 20th century. We will start from the sources of cubism, by presenting what the artists saw and looked at to free themselves from all the academic conventions of this time. We will also see that music had a very important place in the works of this movement as in the work "Musical Instruments" by Georges Braque.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Wim Delvoye" at the Royal Museum of Fine Arts of Belgium in Brussels. This exhibition tries to represent the works of the artist Wim Delvoye as well as possible. You will be able to observe emblematic works of the artist such as "the tattooed pig".

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private visit takes you to discover the exhibition "Kasimir Zgorecki, photographing "Little Poland" 1924-1939" at the Louvre Museum in Lens. In the middle of the 20th century, Kasimir Zgorecki worked in the mining basin of northern France. This exhibition takes place in a particular context because it is the centenary of the signing of an agreement between France and Poland on emigration and immigration, which led to the massive arrival of Polish workers in France to work in the mines. This is the case of the photographer Kasimir Zgorecki.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, on relève le piquant avec les gastronomes gourmets Tony Singh et Cyrus Todiwala. Les chefs sont accompagnés de David Harper et Natasha Raskin.Partant de Dundee, ils descendent la côte est de l’Écosse jusqu’au village de Rosewell, dans le Midlothian, pour une vente aux enchères. Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'humoriste et animateur Jim Moir et sa femme Nancy Sorrell partent en road trip dans le Kent aujourd'hui.Mieux connu sous le nom de Vic Reeves, Jim apporte sa touche d'humour unique à l'achat d'antiquités. De son côté, Nancy, mannequin et présentatrice télé, sait aussi marchander et elle est très compétitive ! Le couple est accompagné par les experts Charlie Ross et Thomas Plant.Soyez attentif au don surprenant de Jim pour deviner l’âge de presque tout, à Dixon traversant les chutes du Niagara et à une leçon de navigation par longitude.Et surtout, la mystérieuse Mme Parker fera-t-elle son apparition à la vente aux enchères ?

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Aurélie, 36, is the latest to enter the race. For several years now, this native of Lille has been making a living from her little-known but high-profile passion: upcycling. Upcycling requires a lot of qualities, and Aurélie, rather quiet and reserved, hopes they'll help her stand out once the competition gets underway. Completely redecorating a room remains a huge challenge for her, even if she has a few styles that are close to her heart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui c'est sur la route des champignons que Julie nous embarque. Rien de mieux pour occuper ses week-ends qu’une balade en forêt à la recherche de champignons comestibles. Certaines espèces, comme le cèpe ou la girolle, se conservent très bien au congélateur ou, pour les plus patients, en bocaux. Nous aurons également l'occasion de rencontrer deux Chefs passionnés par les champignons, devenus des spécialistes du sujet : Franck Quinton et Régis Marcon. Mais pour l’instant on prend la route, à la découverte de plats typiquement français avec d’étonnants champignons de Paris en Touraine, des morilles dans le Jura, des cèpes en Gironde, des russules charbonnières en Normandie et des coulemelles en Auvergne !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie reprend la route à bord de sa petite voiture rouge pour faire honneur à l’un de ses fruits favoris : la châtaigne. Julie ira à la rencontre de plusieurs producteurs en Ardèche, cuisinera la soupe traditionnelle de la région aux côtés de la pétillante Marithé. Elle fera aussi la recette des marrons glacés maison, avant de filer en Corse pour travailler la farine de châtaignes et les feuilles de son arbre. Ce périple s’achèvera comme toujours avec une recette de chef astucieuse et cette-fois ce sera Claude Brioude qui s’y collera ! Ce chef aime bousculer les codes et travaillera la châtaigne avec le poisson, deux produits de saison que l’on n’a pas forcément l’habitude de marier.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, les plus gourmands ne devraient pas être déçus puisque c’est le chocolat qui est mis à l’honneur. Découvert par les mayas il y 2500 ans et plus largement ensuite par les Aztèques, le chocolat fait partie aujourd’hui des produits préférés des français. Et qu’on ne s’y trompe pas : au même titre que la cuisine a ses grands chef, le chocolat a aussi ses grands chocolatiers. Coté recettes, Julie fera découvrir un gâteau qu’on ne fait qu’à Saint Émilien et qui associe le chocolat au macaron, avant de rejoindre le Pays Basque pour un dessert qui ne manque pas de piment. Nous grimperons ensuite en montagne à la rencontre d’une cuisinière d’origine suisse qui fait des pains au chocolat à sa façon. Enfin, vous verrez que le chocolat nous réserve de nombreuses surprises : il possède de nombreuses vertus et s’utilise aussi pour le bien être.

programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, c'est l'heure du verdict. Les quatre chantiers sont terminés. Les candidats vont faire face aux critiques de leurs adversaires et découvrir leurs notes. Mais surtout, les propriétaires vont enfin rentrer chez eux et découvrir leur pièce entièrement redécorée. Que penseront-ils de leur nouvel intérieur ? Quels points vont-ils attribuer ? Car leurs notes peuvent tout faire basculer et renverser le classement actuel. Qui repartira avec les 2000 € et le titre d’As de la déco de la semaine ?

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous emmène en Bretagne sud et plus précisément dans le quartier maritime du Guilvinec pour faire avec vous la route du poisson depuis les filets jusqu’à vos assiettes. Le Guilvinec a beau être le premier port de pêche artisanale français, tous les bords de mers de l’hexagone réservent de bons produits de saison. Julie remonte donc en voiture pour découvrir dans le sud un certain nombre de poissons d’élevage dans une ferme aquacole en Méditerranée, tout en cuisinant le bar à Noirmoutier, la lotte dans le Nord et même le cabillaud dans l’immense marché de Rungis. Julie a challengé le Chef Olivier Bellin installé à Plomodiern dans le Finistère, pour qu’il cuisine un poisson méconnu : la vieille.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Direction le Loir-et-Cher pour une chasse à courre encadrée par les équipes de l’ONCFS. Prenons ensuite la route des Vosges pour cuisiner aux côtés de Mauricette une savoureuse gigue de cerf. Allons à la rencontre de Pierre en Côte d’Or où il fabrique des trompes de chasse, un outil indispensable à la vénerie. Julie retrouvera aussi deux chasseurs girondins pour une après-midi de chasse à la tonne dès plus originale avant de rejoindre Joël en Aquitaine pour une autre recette de gibier à plume. Nous parlerons ensuite avec Laurent du métier de piqueux : ce dresseur de chiens destinés à la vénerie. Cette fois-ci ce sera Frédéric Robert qui nous concoctera une recette de lièvre frotté au cacao et cuit dans un sarcophage d’argile.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tendre et savoureux, l’agneau tient une place prépondérante dans la cuisine festive mais aussi dans celle de tous les jours. Du Pays Basque au Cotentin en passant par Paris, Julie part donc sur les routes de France à la découverte des différentes races et types d'élevage existant à travers le pays. Il faut dire que la France a l'une des productions les plus variées au monde. Il existe plus d'une quarantaine de races répertoriées en 5 catégories : précoces, d’herbage, rustiques, mérinos et laitières. Mais plus qu’à la race, c’est à la façon dont ils sont alimentés qui intéresse les fins connaisseurs. Julie nous fait découvrir ses producteurs et cuisiniers de ce met raffiné !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana cuisine avec l'interprète du titre phare de La Reine des Neiges : Anaïs Delva. Ensemble, elles vont préparer deux recettes 100% végétariennes, philosophie adoptée par la chanteuse. Au menu : fettucini de courgettes grillées, haricots blancs au pesto et burger végétarien. Comme quoi, il est possible de se régaler avec des plats végétariens sans rester sur sa faim !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo cuisine un poisson de la Méditerranée, le rouget. Au menu : filets de rouget avec de la purée d'avocat et des carottes au cumin, et mille-feuille de rouget avec des légumes printaniers.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: We begin in Nendaz at the MAD Retreat, where Mike experiences aerial yoga, blending strength, flexibility, and mindfulness. From there, we visit a Kneipp hydrotherapy facility, learning how cold water, movement, and contrast therapy support circulation, resilience, and mental clarity.In the UNESCO Moorlands of Interlaken, we explore pristine alpine ecosystems and discover traditional herbal remedies passed down through Swiss generations. The episode culminates in a summit of a Swiss Alp with new friends, celebrating movement, nature, community, and the healing power of mountains.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: After a whirlwind 30 days across the globe, Mike and Braeden retreat into nature to reflect on the powerful stories, lessons, and encounters that shaped the season.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: At the VitalLife Scientific Wellness Center at Bumrungrad Hospital in Bangkok, Mike and Braeden undergo some of the most advanced longevity testing available today. Through comprehensive genetic panels, metabolic assessments, cardiovascular imaging, cellular aging analysis, and biomarker evaluations, they gain a deep understanding of their current and future health.They then undergo hyperbaric oxygen therapy, targeted light therapy, and personalized consultations to interpret their results and identify pathways for improving health span. The episode offers a rare look inside the future of preventive medicine and the growing global movement toward longevity science.Here, technology and tradition converge, revealing how we can extend not just our lifespan, but the years we remain healthy, active, and fulfilled.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: Our Swiss journey begins at the Neuro Culinary Center, where a gastroenterology researcher demonstrates how sugar affects blood glucose in real time. Through hands-on testing, we see immediate physiological responses, sparking conversations about metabolism, diet, and long-term health.Next, we visit the Herb Hotel, where hyper-local alpine ingredients create rich, grounded flavours connected to season and place. We learn traditional cheese-making methods before visiting Salzano, a renowned Green Michelin Star restaurant known for elevating Swiss mountain cuisine.The day ends with a sunset hike up a mountain, finishing with raclette melted over an open flame—a perfect celebration of the region’s flavour, simplicity, and beauty.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In Scotland, we investigate whether lifestyle, passions, and even abilities can be influenced by ancestral culture. We begin by training with one of the greatest Highland Games athletes of all time, learning traditional events like the caber toss and stone lift—sports rooted deeply in Scottish heritage.We then visit a weaving workshop to create a custom family tartan, connecting lineage and identity through colour and pattern. At the historic grounds of St. Andrews Golf Course, we explore the origins of golf and its cultural significance.The episode ends with a climb on the Balmoral Estate to Prince Albert’s Cairn, a stunning monument overlooking the Scottish Highlands. Here, we reflect on whether heritage shapes more than identity—perhaps even the activities, environments, and traditions we feel drawn to.

programme.desc: This powerful episode follows a group of Canadian students—many from small, rural communities—as they embark on their first journey outside the country. Cambodia becomes their living classroom, offering lessons rarely found in textbooks.Together, we explore temples, farms, and cultural sites, witnessing their evolving perspectives as they encounter new customs, foods, and ways of life. At Angkor Wat, students learn how history, spirituality, and mindfulness have shaped Cambodian culture for centuries.The transformations are immediate and profound. Students reflect on global inequality, cultural resilience, and what it means to see the world through new eyes. This episode is a celebration of experiential education and the life-changing impact of travel on young minds.

Fra juli til oktober, når gnuene strømmer gjennom Mara, søker det fastboende dyrelivet ly i sine egne territorier og skjermet fra kaoset. Nå er de endelig frie og kan bevege seg rundt i et gnufritt Mara. Vi avslører hvordan disse utrolige dyrene lever livene sine frem til neste juli måned.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Fra den islagte villmarken på Svalbard til den solfylte kysten av Middelhavet – Europa er et kontinent med utrolige landskap fylt med ville skapninger. Her jakter hvalene langs kysten, isbjørner forfølger bytte på frosne sletter, ørner flyr over Alpene, og rever løper rundt i bysentrum. Med fantastiske bilder drar vi ut på en ambisiøs reise for å vise frem Europas imponerende og varierte dyreliv på en helt ny måte.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europas fjellkjeder ruver høyt over kystbyene og former de mest avsidesliggende områdene. De er like slående som de er farlige. Her oppe i høyden er dyrene på en evig jakt for å finne mat. Kongeørner scanner Alpene på jakt etter bytte, hjortedyr kjemper om tilgang til gressområder i det skotske høylandet, og berberapene i Gibraltar finpusser kidnappingsteknikken sin.

programme.title: Dyrenes Fight Club
programme.desc: Løver møtes til duell, ulver tar seg av en grizzlybjørn og én av verdens største apekatter har drapsplaner.

programme.title: Dyrenes Fight Club
programme.desc: Afrika er hjem til naturens mest fryktede rovdyr som geparder, løver og hyener med flere. I villmarken er kampen om overlevelse aldri ensidig. Selv om Afrikas drapsmaskiner er noen av de beste jegerne i dyreriket, er byttedyrene deres formidable på sin egen måte. Vær vitne til at en gepardmor møtes ansikt til ansikt med en gaselles kraftige våpen, og se hva som skjer når tre hann-løver gjør sitt livs feil, og prøver å slakte et stridslystent neshorn.

programme.title: Dyrenes Fight Club
programme.desc: På planeten vår er det flere arter som kolliderer i naturens ville kamp for overlevelse. Fra elefanthanner som kjemper om en gruppe hunner, til en kamp mellom en løveflokk og en sulten hyene-klan, disse drapsmaskinene kjemper med tenner og klør for å vinne mat, territorier og retten til slektslinjen. Vær vitne til slåss-evnene til planetens mest fryktløse skapninger i det de kjemper for overlevelsen i de dødeligste konflikter.

programme.title: Dyrenes Fight Club
programme.desc: Et blikk på naturens kaldblodigste mordere. Enkelte er eksperter på bakholdsangrep, noen har skarpe hoggtenner og andre kan kvele deg i hjel.

programme.title: Dyrenes Fight Club
programme.desc: En hunnleopard slåss om lunsjen mot en stor hann, og se hvordan nilvaranen bruker halen som et dødelig våpen.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Den store julehøytiden er på vei, men alt er ikke like trivelig. Dr. Pol behandler hoven til et reinsdyr før han undersøker en forlatt hundevalp. Dr. Nicole rykker ut til en ku som har oppført seg rart, og dr. Lisa hjelper en katt som sliter med å puste.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.sub-title: Alle for én, og én for Pol
programme.desc: Da en gås, en kanin og en drektig hund kommer til klinikken, samarbeider teamet for å hjelpe dyrene i nød. Dr. Pol ordner gips til en skadet kalv, dr. Lisa jakter på to geiter og dr. Brenda tar grep da symptomene til et reinsdyr plutselig endrer seg.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: I Sør-Afrikas villmark blir dyrene desperate i de tørre vintermånedene. Sultne krokodiller sloss mot en farlig gruppe flodhester, flodhestene prøver seg på en gruppe hannløver, en honninggrevling kjemper for livet mot leoparder, og villhunder skaper komplett kaos hvor enn de går.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Når savannen blir en slagmark ser vi på fra sidelinjen når en leopard blir trengt opp i et hjørne av en løveflokk. En ung impala blir kastet opp i luften av en flodhest, to hyener prøver å drukne hverandre og et jordsvin står ansikt til ansikt med en brunhyene.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Store kattedyr ses kanskje på som den ultimate klisjéen for ville dyr, men de er midt i en global kamp for å overleve. De er sterke og farlige, og nå går de i klinsj med mennesker mer enn noensinne. Denne ville safarien avslører deres motstands- og tilpasningsdyktighet. Geparder jakter fra biler, jaguarer sniker seg innpå bytte under vann og rundt båter, og Indias løver jakter i byens gater. Kjente arter og oppførsler skaper nytt drama, med avsløringer som bekrefter hvorfor store pattedyr er de farligste rovdyrene.

programme.title: Amerikas ville steder
programme.desc: National Geographic blir med på en spennende reise over 445 kilometer for å utforske Grand Canyon og dens mysterier.

programme.title: Amerikas ville steder
programme.desc: Naturreservatet Papahanaumokuakea strekker seg over de nordvestre øyene til Hawaii.

programme.title: Race to Winter
programme.desc: Når vårens første lys glir over fjordene, skogene, fjellene og tundraen, starter den store oppvåkningen. Brunbjørnmødrene kommer ut av vinterdvalen, og leder ungene sine ut i en helt ny verden. Lundefuglene gjenforenes med sine livspartnere, og isbjørnene vandrer rundt på den smeltende isen. Men de har lite tid - skyggen av vinteren lurer. Og I dette uendelige løpet mot kulden er det kun de mest motstandsdyktige som klarer seg.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: Bambusskogen i Kina er full av hemmeligheter og overraskelser, som den legendariske kjempepandaen, rødpanda, tibetmakak og uvanlige skapninger som blomstermantis, flaggermus og emeipadder. Alle har funnet seg til rette i det store gressriket.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: Livet er hardt på de store gresslettene i Kina. Området herjes av voldsomme stormer året gjennom så innbyggerne må være tilpasningsdyktige og hardføre for å overleve her. Under de tre sommermånedene må dyrene utnytte muligheten til å oppdra ungene før høsten og vinteren setter inn.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet

programme.title: Mashatu: Land Of Leopards
programme.desc: I viltreservatet Mashatu i Botswana, et av de siste fristedene for frittgående leoparder, føder en mor to unger. Hun vil gjøre alt for å beskytte dem. Men når klimaendringer strammer grepet, forsvinner ressurser, og en tøff leopardkrig er i emming. Denne filmen er basert på tre år med nøye observasjon, og avdekker sjeldne og utrolige bilder av oppførsel som ikke tidligere har blitt dokumentert, og tilbyr et helt nytt innblikk i motstandsdyktigheten og hemmelighetene til denne sky arten.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Turister fanger de beste øyeblikkene i villmarken med telefonene sine, og de store kattedyrere står øverst på alles ønskeliste på safari. Hold deg fast når en elefant angriper med en løve på støttennene. Se hannleoparder kjempe om revir, og vær obs på en leopardmors jaktskole. Geparder konfronterer krokodiller for å beskytte måltidet sitt. Store bøffelflokker samles mens en enslig løve viser hvorfor han er kongen.

programme.title: Vill vinter
programme.desc: Å overleve i skogene nord i Finland er et kappløp mot årstidene, med sin grove villmark og ekstreme klima. Vi følger det utrolige dagliglivet til en brunbjørnmor som risikerer alt for å oppdra ungene sine. Hun kommer ut av vinterdvalen tynn og sliten, og må lede ungene gjennom en kort sommer der mat – og overlevelse – er det eneste på prioriteringslisten.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Overraskelser kommer i alle former og størrelser. En nymfekakadu har et skjevt nebb og dr. Lisa undersøker en gårdskatts blærelekkasje. Når en chihuahua ankommer timer senere med et akutt øyeproblem, beholder legene fokuset. En alvorlig skjønnhetsfeil dukker opp på en konkurransehund, og en hes hest sliter med å puste. Alle samarbeider for å gjøre Dianes bursdag ekstra spesiell.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.sub-title: Det bøtter på med katter og hunder
programme.desc: En ny sau er på vei til Pols gård, og familien ordner dreneringen i sauehuset. Den kalde vinteren er på vei, så det stinkende stedet må fikses raskt.

programme.title: Verdens dødeligste slanger
programme.desc: Slanger i Afrika blir rangert fra minst til mest dødelig. I Afrika er mambaer og kobraer farlige og dødelige, men med pytoner, huggormer og verdens giftigste snoker lagt til i miksen, er det mange flere uventede kandidater som kjemper om tittelen om å være dødeligst.

programme.title: Verdens dødeligste slanger
programme.desc: Hvilken slange er den farligste i Amerika? Det er lett å tro at det enten er klapperslanger og anakondaer, men det finnes noen uventede utfordrere. I World’s Deadliest Snakes blir hver av dem rangert, og den farligste og dødeligste avsløres.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz tar fatt på en Nissan Pulsar GTI-R fra 1990, fast bestemt på ikke bare å restaurere den, men også å finne ut hvorfor det rallyinspirerte ikonet aldri ble den ultimate hot hatch-modellen.

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: Det ser lysere ut når en ikonisk amerikansk pickup fra 1950-tallet gir Cogs en spennende mulighet til å delta på sin første bilutstilling. Det blir et kappløp med tiden å få den gamle pickupen tilbake i topp stand til det store arrangementet. De starter en rekrutteringskampanje for nye medarbeidere fordi en invitasjon til å jobbe med en unik sportsbil understreker behovet for flere Cogs. En banedag på Goodwood gir Richard sjansen til å imponere de store aktørene i den klassiske bilverdenen. Det gir han en invitasjon til å delta i sesongens største klassiske bilrace.

programme.title: Egypts tapte skatter
programme.desc: Hvorfor valgte de store faraoene Kongenes dal som sin gravplass? I skyggen av pyramidene gjøres et ekstraordinært funn i en sjelden 4500 år gammel grav. 100 meter under jorden undersøkes den første graven som ble bygget i dalen, mens et team fra Universitet i Basel jakter på ledetråder for å identifisere menneskelige levninger som er funnet i plyndrede graver.

programme.title: Egypts tapte skatter
programme.desc: Vi følger arkeologer på leting etter dronning Kleopatras tapte grav. Et team av arkeologer dykker ned i Middelhavet for å utforske de forliste ruinene av Alexandria. Et annet team tar en gruppe 4000 år gamle mumier til sykehuset for å lete etter skjulte skatter. Og en advokat, som har blitt arkeolog, oppdager et hemmelig tunnelenettverk som kan føre henne til graven til Egyptens siste farao.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Sikkerhetsagenter i Orange County jobber i skjul for å kjøpe metamfetamin og fentanyl fra flere langere. Ved havnen i Savannah oppdager man stjålne biler til en verdi av over 250 000 dollar gjemt i kontainere. I El Paso pågriper grensevaktene flere som har krysset grensemuren, og ved grenseovergangen stopper man menneskesmuglere på vei tilbake til Mexico.

programme.title: Hvordan fange en smugler
programme.desc: Sikkerhetsagentene i San Diego blir tipset om at en bil med narkotika har krysset grensen. Kjøretøyet spores til en leilighet i Long Beach, og de finner metamfetamin til en verdi av 350 000 dollar gjemt i bilen. I Philadelphia prøver agentene ut et nytt apparat som kan påvise narkotika gjemt blant lasten på fly.

programme.title: Når katastrofen inntreffer
programme.desc: Vi tar en inngående, hjerteskjærende titt på den dødeligste herjingen i Indias historie, som så ti terrorister drepe foran verdens kameraer i nesten tre grufulle dager.

programme.title: Konstruksjons-katastrofer
programme.desc: Tungtransporten i Kina har forferdelige konsekvenser; utallige veier og motorveier kollapser. I denne episoden ser vi også nærmere på beltegående kraner, tungvektsmesterne i byggebransjen.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: I denne spesielle episoden hopper guttene inn i Tims egen Mustang-fastback fra 1965 for en biltur omkring i Storbritannia for å besøke noen av favorittbilene deres fra de fire siste sesongene. De får vite hvordan livet har endret seg for de heldige eierne. Underveis stopper de ved noen merkesteder for bilfantaster, og vi får se tidligere usett klipp fra hele serien.

programme.title: Nazistenes byggverk
programme.desc: Vi hører historien om forsvarsvollen som strakte seg over tusenvis av kilometer. Det tredje riket bygde den for å forsvare seg mot de allierte.

programme.title: Nazistenes byggverk
programme.desc: Nazisten og vitenskapsmannen Wernher von Braun sto bak den ballistiske raketten og la det teknologiske grunnlaget for kampen om verdensrommet.

programme.title: Flyhavarikommisjonen
programme.desc: Et pakistansk fly krasjer i Himalaya, og når det mest vitale beviset ikke leverer, må etterforskerne kare seg frem til svar.

programme.title: Europa fra oven
programme.desc: Denne spektakulære luftreisen avslører Finland slik vi aldri har sett det før. Flygende kameraer flyr langs gigantiske skip som knuser stier gjennom havisen, svever opp for å avsløre verdens rareste badstue, og oppdager utfordringene Europas siste urfolk står overfor. Vi flyr over Finlands ville og avsidesliggende landskap for å avsløre hvordan de innovative finnene bruker tradisjonelle trelastflytende teknikker for å tilpasse en viktig industri til en verden i endring.

programme.title: Alaskas siste utpost
programme.desc: Etter at skurker truer den lokale vannkilden, må Veronica, Jiggy og Dave Palmer sørge for å holde dem med vann og strøm. Samtidig hjelper Squibb Troy og Sarah med å bygge en gangvei til huset sitt. Curly og Junior finner spor etter svartbjørn mens de er på jakt, og Matts datter kommer tilbake til byen for sommeren.

programme.title: Alaskas siste utpost
programme.desc: Etter en god bjørnejakt forbereder Curly seg på å slakte byttet sitt. Samtidig sliter Troy og Sarah med å bære 40-liters vanntanker opp en bratt åsside. Jiggy og Gale lager nye, hjemmelagde sluker til fiskeutstyret sitt, og Oliver og Breanna bygger en ny tidevannsheis som hele lokalsamfunnet vil ha nytte av.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Agenter fra Air and Marine Operations i Fajardo forfølger et fartøy til en marina. De mistenkte flykter, og etterlater seg 280 kg kokain gjemt om bord. AMO-agentene i Mayagüez bidrar med væpnet transport av en drapsmistenkt fra sjøen til flyplassen. Senere avskjærer de et migrantfartøy ved å skyte i stykker motoren. Agenter på på U.S. Virgin Island beslaglegger over $750k i kontanter fra et smuglerfartøy.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Agenter fra Air and Marine Operations i U.S. Virgin Islands ber om hjelp fra U.S. Border Patrols taktiske enhet BORTAC for å plukke fra hverandre en smuglerliga på St. John. AMO-agentene i Fajardo følger et fartøy som går på grunn, med 1300 kg kokain. Vest i Puerto Rico hjelper agenter fra Mayagüez-kontoret den amerikanske kystvakten med å redde migranter som har gått overbord i sjøen.

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: Cogs-teamet utformer designet til et helt nytt britisk motorsykkelmerke. Den unike forretningsmuligheten fører dem til verdens mest prestisjefylte motorsykkelløp, Isle of Man TT, for å presentere syklene. På verkstedet blir en Mini totalrestaurert etter en kollisjon. Richard havner i knipe når Hadrian forbyr Cogs å delta i løpet. Richard har lovt at han skal kjøre, så det er bare én ting å gjøre – han rekrutterer sine gamle venner Les og Zog som støtteapparat.

programme.title: Flyhavarikommisjonen
programme.desc: TACA Airlines Flight 110, Boeing 737-300, 24. mai 1988. Flyet flyr gjennom et voldsomt tordenvær og begynner sin siste nedstigning mot New Orleans da begge motorene svikter og flyet faller gjennom luften. Pilotene starter begge motorene på nytt, men nesten umiddelbart overopphetes de og tvinger pilotene til å slå dem av igjen. Uten drivkraft for andre gang faller flyet raskt. De vurderer å nødlande i en kanal, men sikter i stedet på et smalt dike. Med 38 passasjerer om bord, utfører pilotene en av de mest bemerkelsesverdige landinger i kommersiell luftfartshistorie. Det blir opp til etterforskerne å finne ut hvorfor motorene til et helt nytt Boeing 737 sviktet under flyvningen.

programme.title: Flyhavarikommisjonen
programme.desc: SAS Flight 686 Boeing MD-87, 8. oktober 2001. En tung tåke dekker Milanos flyplass Linate mens SAS Flight 686 forbereder seg på en rutinemessig flytur til København. Pilotene har nesten ingen sikt og er helt avhengige av bakkekontrollere for å navigere flyet i posisjon for avgang. Flyet akselererer nedover rullebanen, men da det letter, kolliderer det med en Cessna som er i veien. Cessna-flyet bryter ut i flammer. MD-87 smeller i bakken og glir inn i en bagasjehangar. Flyet eksploderer i sammenstøtet. Det er den verste ulykken i italiensk luftfartshistorie, og etterforskningen avdekker en serie sjokkerende feil. I etterkant blir en flyplass endret, og de som anses som ansvarlige blir dømt i retten.

programme.title: Tucci i Italia
programme.desc: Stanley oppdager Sicilia, en øy full av kontraster der den flerkulturelle historien har satt et deilig preg på maten og folket. Han nyter blodappelsiner fra de gamle grekerne, safranrik arancini fra araberne, og røde reker fisket opp av øyas dyktige tunisiske fiskere.

programme.title: Konstruksjons-katastrofer
programme.desc: Et stort reklameskilt faller ned i Mumbai, store mengder snø får et tak til å rase sammen i Minnesota, i São Paolo kollapser T-banetunneler og nifse "spøkelsesskyskrapere" står uferdige.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz hjelper en veldedig organisasjon med å redde en livreddende Defender fra skraphaugen.

programme.title: Flyhavarikommisjonen: Spesialrapport
programme.desc: Tre ulykker avslører at skruer og muttere som ikke sjekkes godt nok kan føre til katastrofe. En mekanikers feilvurdering fører til en fryktelig ulykke i Texas. Dårlig vedlikehold gjør at tre transportflypiloter må kjempe for livet. Da et propellfly forsvinner i Nordsjøen, avslører etterforskerne et forbryternettverk på en annen verdensdel.

programme.title: Car S.o.s.
programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz står overfor sin største utfordring, å restaurere en Alfa Romeo Spider fra 1968.

programme.desc: Den amerikanske kongressmannen Leo Ryan avslørte den virkelige skrekken bak pastor Jim Jones' religiøse samfunn langt inne i Guyanas jungel.

programme.title: Konstruksjons-katastrofer
programme.desc: Vi studerer et av verdens mest brukte bygningsmaterialer, sement. Og vi tar turen til Skottland for å besøke Glasgow Tower, verdens høyeste fullt roterende tårn.

programme.desc: Tim og Fuzz jobber med et italiensk ikon: en Fiat 500 fra 1967. En tragisk hendelse forhindret eieren Duncan i å fikse bilen, så gutta trår til.

programme.title: Nazistenes byggverk
programme.desc: Nazisten og vitenskapsmannen Wernher von Braun sto bak den ballistiske raketten og la det teknologiske grunnlaget for kampen om verdensrommet.

programme.title: Nazistenes byggverk
programme.desc: Nazistenes ingeniører hadde som oppgave å oppfylle Hitlers stormannsgale krav om å lage et slagskip på land som veide 1000 tonn.

programme.title: Flyhavarikommisjonen
programme.desc: Et kargofly går i bakken nord i Sverige, og krateret maler et forferdelig bilde av flyet som treffer bakken – opp ned og nesten i lydens hastighet. Svenske etterforskere funderer over bevisene, og når de finner ut hva som skjedde, konkluderer de med at krasjet var en respons på en nødssituasjon som ikke eksisterte.

programme.title: Europa fra oven
programme.desc: Unik luftfotografering avslører Frankrikes hemmeligheter, et kulturelt kraftverk som ligger i et stort landskap med kontraster og overraskelser. Våre flygende kameraer svever over skarpe fjell og skjulte gårder utenfor kysten, mens ingeniører balanserer over en rekordsterk bro, høyere enn Eiffeltårnet. Vi glir mellom felt av lavendel, idylliske fjellbeiter og Versailles' skjulte perler, og oppdager verdens største takgård i Paris.

programme.title: Alaskas siste utpost

programme.title: Alaskas siste utpost
programme.desc: Selv midt på sommeren stopper ikke beboerne i Port Protection å arbeide. Sam og Sarah støtter Troy når han skal fiske med spyd, Matt og Terry hjelper Squibb med å reparere en gammel brygge, og Curly lærer Oliver hvordan han kan felle trær helt nøyaktig. Samtidig faller fiskeprisen, og Carl prøver å få maksimal fangst han kan selge.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Agenter fra Air and Marine Operations i U.S. Virgin Islands ber om hjelp fra U.S. Border Patrols taktiske enhet BORTAC for å plukke fra hverandre en smuglerliga på St. John. programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Homeland Security Investigations Puerto Rico arresterer 37 medlemmer av et smuglernettverk som står bak flere drap, og både import og eksport av kokain på øya. Agenter fra Air and Marine Operations i Mayagüez jakter på en fullastet farkost med kokain tll en verdi av $5,4 millioner om bord. AMO-agentene i Fajardo etterforsker en festbåt og oppdager at en av passasjerene om bord kom inn i landet på ulovlig vis.

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: De nye mekanikerne kommer til verkstedet og tar fatt på to krevende oppgaver: å restaurere en unik konseptbil fra 1960-tallet og lakke om en sjelden Lotus. Er de gode nok til å klare oppgaven? Hadrian gjenopptar arbeidet med Richards Stanley-dampbil, men drømmen om å få det hundre år gamle kjøretøyet tilbake på veien går i stå når han oppdager at det har alvorlige problemer med kjelen. Og på Prescott Hill hjelper de gamle vennene Les og Zog Richard når han skal lede løpet for en dag, slik at han kan kvalifisere seg til å kjøre på Silverstone Festival.

programme.title: Flyhavarikommisjonen
programme.desc: United Airlines Flight 232 DC-10, 19. juli 1989. Flyet er 37 000 fot over Iowa da en av de tre motorene eksploderer. Pilotene slår den av, men oppdager snart at de har et mye mer alvorlig problem. Flyet heller bratt mot høyre, og pilotene klarer ikke å gjenopprette riktig retning. DC-10 har feil i alle hydrauliske systemer, og den eneste måten pilotene kan manøvrere flyet på er ved å veksle mellom de to gjenværende motorene. Pilotene klarer å fly det skadde flyet til nærmeste flyplass, men uten å kunne konfigurere vingene for en normal landing, har de ikke annet valg enn å holde motorene på nesten full kraft. Etter et krasj som dreper 111 av de 296 om bord, må etterforskerne finne ut hvorfor et idiotsikkert system feilet.

programme.title: Clarkson's Farm
programme.desc: Etter mange måneder med hardt arbeid kommer Clarksons gård til et avgjørende øyeblikk: innhøstingen. Ting begynner dårlig når Jeremy må skaffe en essensiell maskin på kort varsel før han jobber dag og natt for å høste inn hundrevis av mål med avlinger før regnet vender tilbake og ødelegger dem. Mens tiden løper ut, ødelegger Clarkson sitt eget harde arbeid, Kaleb mister tålmodigheten og en gammel venn fra The Grand Tour blir hentet inn for å hjelpe.

programme.desc: Fortellingen om en av de største endringene i sportens historie har blitt fortalt. Eller har den? På en fredagskveld i Lake Placid i New York lamslo en modig gruppe amerikanske kollegiater det oppskrytte sovjetiske landslaget 4-3 i medaljerunden av ishockey under vinter-OL i 1980. Amerikanerne trodde på mirakler den kvelden, og når deltakerne på Team USA vant gullmedaljen to dager senere, ble de et legendarisk lag.

programme.title: Egypts tapte skatter
programme.desc: Arkeologer undersøker en av de største kvinnelige faraoene i historien: Hatshepsut. Ledetråder i templet hennes avslører mye om hennes makt. Et sjeldent funn i et av de eldgamle steinbruddene hennes fører til en undersøkelse som leder til det praktfulle tempelet Karnak. Og en arkeolog avdekker dramatiske bevis knyttet til kvinners liv i det gamle Egypt mens han graver ut mumier.

programme.desc: I El Paso patruljerer CBP lasteanlegget og oppdager kokain til en million dollar skjult i en frysevogn.
